summary: Solo Superman is safe to verify as a limited technical preview, but general release remains blocked until signed packages, packaged update rollback evidence, and Windows real-device verification are complete.

releaseGates.blocker: Apple Developer ID/notarization and Windows Authenticode credentials are not present in the local credential-free environment.
requiredEvidence: macOS DMG/PKG codesign verification, notarization status, and stapling evidence
Windows MSI/EXE Authenticode signature and timestamp verification
release manifest signature produced after final artifact checksum/signature refs are known
unblockCriteria: Run pnpm verify:signed-package-preflight -- --require-credentials in a release environment with signing credential refs
Attach redacted signing, notarization, and timestamp verification evidence to the release PR
Run pnpm verify:signed-package-release -- --require-release-evidence with redacted signing and manifest evidence

releaseGates.blocker: The packaged app updater has manifest/signature/checksum/retry/rollback contract and credential-free fixture dry-run coverage, but signed package device rollback verification is not complete.
requiredEvidence: macOS and Windows install/update/defer/retry/rollback runs on signed packages
launch verification after update and after rollback
proof that rollback changes only app binary/release metadata and preserves local data, generated workspaces, support bundles, and credentials

passed rollback runs include structured evidenceBundle data with version transition, per-check evidence refs, protected-path preservation refs, metadata-only credential snapshot mode, redaction refs, and passed checks
unblockCriteria: Record device evidence for install, update, retry, rollback, and launch verification
Keep pnpm verify:release-channel passing with final signed artifact metadata

releaseGates.blocker: The Windows PowerShell path is documented but still needs clean Windows 11 device or VM verification from one-line install through first-screen arrival.
requiredEvidence: Clean Windows 11 one-line install reaches the local first screen
UAC, Node/Git/Corepack/pnpm, WSL/Ubuntu/Codex CLI, Visual C++ runtime, desktop shortcut, rerun, and safe update paths match the docs
support bundle and bootstrap/prod-smoke log evidence are attached for any failure path

passed Windows real-device runs include a structured evidenceBundle with device profile metadata, per-check evidence refs, first-screen evidence, support bundle summary, bootstrap log, prod-smoke log, redaction report, and passed checks
unblockCriteria: Complete issue #259 with real Windows device or VM evidence
Split any discovered blocker into a fix issue/PR before changing broad release status
Run pnpm verify:windows-real-device -- --require-device-evidence with redacted Windows device or VM evidence
